description: What the Foundation node's LLM rotation (unhardcoded / morpheus / pearl) is doing: calls, failures, timeouts, latency, fallbacks, and the model unhardcoded served.

panels.title: Foundation node — every LLM call (time range)

panels.description: LLM prompts the node ran in the selected range (one per gl.nondet LLM call a contract made). Attempts = provider calls, so Attempts > Prompts means fallbacks happened.
panels.title: Prompts

panels.description: Share of prompts that got an answer from SOME provider. A miss here means every provider in the chain failed (NO_PROVIDER_FOR_PROMPT) — the contract call fails.
panels.title: Answered

panels.description: Share of prompts the FIRST provider tried answered — no fallback needed.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(count_over_time({validator_name="$validator", filename="/var/log/genlayer/node-llm-calls.log"} | json | __error__="" | event="prompt" | ok=`true` | attempts=`1` [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({validator_name="$validator", filename="/var/log/genlayer/node-llm-calls.log"} | json | __error__="" | event="prompt" [$__range]))

panels.title: First try

panels.description: Provider attempts that failed (any reason), and of those the timeouts (HTTP 408/504, or an error mentioning a timeout).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({validator_name="$validator", filename="/var/log/genlayer/node-llm-calls.log"} | json | __error__="" | event="attempt" | ok=`false` | error_kind=~"timeout|gateway_timeout" or error=~"(?i).*time.?out.*" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Failures

panels.description: USD unhardcoded charged the Foundation node's key in the selected range, and over the key's whole life (from the router's own report, polled on the node every 5 min).

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({validator_name="$validator", filename="/var/log/genlayer/node-llm-unhardcoded.log"} | json | __error__="" | event="router_request" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Unhardcoded spend

panels.description: Provider attempts per hour, by provider. The rotation picks a random lead per session, so over time the three should be roughly even — a provider that is never tried first is being skipped (e.g. morpheus has no JSON mode, so JSON prompts skip it).
panels.title: Calls per provider

panels.description: Failed attempts per hour, by provider and reason (error_kind from the HTTP status: timeout, gateway_timeout, rate_limit, server_error, auth_error, network_error, …).

targets.expr: sum by (provider, error_kind) (count_over_time({validator_name="$validator", filename="/var/log/genlayer/node-llm-calls.log"} | json | __error__="" | event="attempt" | ok=`false` [$__interval]))

panels.title: Failures per provider

panels.description: 95th percentile wall time of a SUCCESSFUL provider call, per hour. Points, not lines: calls are sparse.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {validator_name="$validator", filename="/var/log/genlayer/node-llm-calls.log"} | json | __error__="" | event="attempt" | ok=`true` | unwrap ms [$__interval]) by (provider)

panels.title: Latency per provider (p95)

panels.description: Prompts per hour by the path the rotation took: lead > fallback > … (providers_tried). A long chain means the lead keeps failing.
panels.title: Fallbacks

panels.description: One row per provider over the selected range. Tried first = attempt #1 of a prompt (normally the session's rotation lead; if the lead can't take the prompt, the next one). As fallback = tried after another provider failed.

targets.expr: sum by (provider) (count_over_time({validator_name="$validator", filename="/var/log/genlayer/node-llm-calls.log"} | json | __error__="" | event="attempt" | ok=`false` | error_kind=~"timeout|gateway_timeout" or error=~"(?i).*time.?out.*" [$__range]))
avg_over_time({validator_name="$validator", filename="/var/log/genlayer/node-llm-calls.log"} | json | __error__="" | event="attempt" | ok=`true` | unwrap ms [$__range]) by (provider)
quantile_over_time(0.95, {validator_name="$validator", filename="/var/log/genlayer/node-llm-calls.log"} | json | __error__="" | event="attempt" | ok=`true` | unwrap ms [$__range]) by (provider)
sum by (provider) (sum_over_time({validator_name="$validator", filename="/var/log/genlayer/node-llm-calls.log"} | json | __error__="" | event="attempt" | ok=`true` | unwrap tokens_total [$__range]))

panels.title: By provider

panels.description: For each session's rotation lead, which provider actually answered the prompt. Off-diagonal rows are fallbacks or lead skips (morpheus has no JSON mode, so JSON prompts skip it).

targets.expr: sum by (lead, provider, ok) (count_over_time({validator_name="$validator", filename="/var/log/genlayer/node-llm-calls.log"} | json | __error__="" | event="prompt" [$__range]))

panels.title: Rotation lead → who answered

panels.description: Every failed provider attempt, newest first. Expand a line for the full record (http_status, error_kind, error causes, tx_id).

targets.expr: {validator_name="$validator", filename="/var/log/genlayer/node-llm-calls.log"} | json | __error__="" | event="attempt" | ok=`false` | line_format `{{.provider}} · {{.error_kind}} {{.http_status}} · {{.ms}}ms · attempt {{.attempt}} · {{.error}} · tx {{.tx_id}}`

panels.title: Failed attempts

panels.description: Every prompt, newest first: who answered, the path taken, and total time.

targets.expr: {validator_name="$validator", filename="/var/log/genlayer/node-llm-calls.log"} | json | __error__="" | event="prompt" | line_format `{{if eq .ok "true"}}OK{{else}}FAILED{{end}} · {{.providers_tried}} · {{.ms}}ms · {{.format}} · lead {{.lead}} · tx {{.tx_id}}`

panels.title: All prompts
Unhardcoded — which model the router actually served

panels.description: Which model unhardcoded's router actually used for the node's `profile:default` requests, in the selected range (x_router.served_model_id). The node itself can't see this.

targets.expr: sum by (served_model) (sum_over_time({validator_name="$validator", filename="/var/log/genlayer/node-llm-unhardcoded.log"} | json | __error__="" | event="router_request" | unwrap tokens_total [$__range]))
sum by (served_model) (sum_over_time({validator_name="$validator", filename="/var/log/genlayer/node-llm-unhardcoded.log"} | json | __error__="" | event="router_request" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

panels.title: Served model

panels.description: Which upstream unhardcoded routed to (antseed, openrouter, bedrock, …), in the selected range.

targets.expr: sum by (upstream) (sum_over_time({validator_name="$validator", filename="/var/log/genlayer/node-llm-unhardcoded.log"} | json | __error__="" | event="router_request" | unwrap tokens_total [$__range]))
sum by (upstream) (sum_over_time({validator_name="$validator", filename="/var/log/genlayer/node-llm-unhardcoded.log"} | json | __error__="" | event="router_request" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

panels.title: Upstream provider

panels.description: Requests per hour on the Foundation node's key, by the model the router picked. Timestamps are when the node's 5-min poll logged them.
panels.title: Unhardcoded requests by served model

panels.description: Every request the router logged for this key, newest first: status, served model, upstream, latency, tokens, cost.

targets.expr: {validator_name="$validator", filename="/var/log/genlayer/node-llm-unhardcoded.log"} | json | __error__="" | event="router_request" | line_format `{{.status}} · {{.served_model}} via {{.upstream}} · {{.latency_ms}}ms · {{.tokens_total}} tok · USD {{.cost_usd}}{{if .error_kind}} · {{.error_kind}}{{end}}`
